title: Army sends border students on tour to Uttarakhand
description: Excelsior Correspondent POONCH, Dec 7: The Indian Army’s Poonch Brigade on Sunday flagged off a National Integration tour for school students from areas located close to the India–Pakistan Line of Control. A total of 25 students and two teachers have been sent outside the district to witness the cultural and geographic diversity of the country. The tour bus was flagged off by Brigadier Sachindra Joshi, Commander Poonch Brigade, along with Deputy Commander Himanshu, in the presence of other officers. As […]

title: Pak criticises Jaishakar's remarks against its military
description: ISLAMABAD, Dec 7:  Pakistan on Sunday criticised External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar’s remarks against its military, saying its institutions, including armed forces, are a pillar of national security. Speaking at the Hindustan Times Leadership Summit in New Delhi on Saturday, Jaishankar said much of India’s problem emanates from Pakistan’s military and even referred to its support for terror groups. title: Pak hits out at Jaishankar for blaming its military for India's security problems
description: Pakistan has strongly rejected External Affairs Minister Jaishankar's recent remarks on its military. The EAM had said many of India's security challenges stem from Pakistan's military establishment and referred to its support for terror groups.

title: Pakistan, Armenia hold talks for embassy in Yerevan
description: Pakistan and Armenia are moving forward to establish diplomatic relations. Discussions are underway to open a Pakistan embassy in Yerevan next year. This development follows the official establishment of diplomatic ties between the two nations on August 31. India is closely observing these events.

title: Israel Urges India To Label Hamas As Terror Group, Cites LeT Ties
description: Israel has urged India to formally designate Hamas as a terrorist organisation, citing that the group's growing ties with Pakistan-based Lashkar-e-Taiba (LeT) and other Iranian proxies pose a growing security threat to both India and Israel.

title: Taliban-aligned group TTP (Tehrik-e-Taliban Pakistan) threatens Pakistan and the United States
description: As India moves closer to the Taliban, the India–Pakistan rift widens, especially as Pakistan continues to be plagued by the Taliban-aligned jihadist group Tehrik-e-Taliban Pakistan (TTP).
